en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Dyad on Cognizable by Some (Kenaciviññeyyaduka).

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and impinging, cognizable by something, there arises a phenomenon that is neither non-demonstrable nor impinging, not cognizable by anything, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and impinging, cognizable by something, there arises a phenomenon that is neither non-demonstrable nor impinging, not cognizable by anything, by way of root condition. [Dependent on] a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable and impinging...

Dependent on a state cognizable by any [sense] that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a state not cognizable by any [sense] arises by way of root condition … [and so on] … Dependent on a state cognizable by any [sense] that is non-demonstrable and reactive,
states arise by way of root condition that are neither demonstrable nor reactive and neither cognizable by any [sense] nor non-cognizable by any [sense] … six.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and cognizable by anyone, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable and non-reacting and is not cognizable by anyone, by way of root condition … (six). Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable,
reacting, and cognizable by anyone, and a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and cognizable by anyone,
there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable and reacting and is not cognizable by anyone, by way of root condition.

... six. (Abbreviated. In the case of root-cause condition, eighteen; in the case of object condition, three ... pe ... in the case of mutuality condition, fifteen ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, eighteen.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible-and-reacting and cognizable by some [consciousness], there arises a state that is neither non-visible-and-reacting nor cognizable by any [consciousness] by way of root-cause condition.
(Abbreviated. In the case of root-cause condition, eighteen; in the case of object condition, three.
... pe ... fifteen with respect to mutual [conditioning] ... pe ... eighteen with respect to non-disappearance.
